formulations.Polymer system Notes: PIGE: statistical copolymer PEO323-stat-PIGE79 (imidazole-functionalized allyl glycidyl ether via thiol-ene click of Im-SH on PEO-stat-PAGE); x_IGE = 0.17; Mn = 40 kDa, D < 1.2 (SEC vs PEO standards); amorphous. Neat polymer, no salt.
formulations.Polymer: PIGE (PEO-stat-imidazole-functionalized glycidyl ether), neat, no salt
